name: Product & UI/UX Design
headline: Website and UI/UX design for clearer digital products.
summary: From the first user flow to the final screen, we help you design and build websites and digital experiences that people understand.
description: Work with Kyte on website design, UX research, interface systems and prototypes. Explore our digital product work for teams in India and beyond.
scope: Research & product strategy
Understand the people using your product, map their journeys and decide what the experience needs to do.
UI & design systems
Bring clarity to your screens with consistent components, responsive layouts and considered interaction states.
Working prototypes
Explore real flows early. Test the direction, gather feedback and resolve important questions before the full build.
Website build & handover
Take an agreed website scope into Framer or collaborate with your developers, with clear specifications and a considered handover.
steps: Understand
Start with your business, users and the problem to solve.
Make it tangible
Turn the direction into flows and working prototypes you can review.
Refine the system
Resolve the details across screens, states and devices.
Build & verify
Carry the design into implementation and check how it works.
fit: You're preparing to launch a digital product.
Your website no longer explains what you do.
Your product has grown, but its experience feels fragmented.
Your team needs a design partner for the next release.
reasons: From idea to implementation
Website cases show how we carry an interface through to a working build.
A system your team can use
Components, interaction states and handover are part of the conversation from the start.
Something to respond to early
Working prototypes make feedback specific, so the next decision is easier to make.
Clear from the start
Deliverables, responsibilities and review stages are agreed around your brief.
faqs: Do you design and build?
We design digital products and build websites, including Framer projects. Application engineering and any specialist integrations are scoped with your team before work starts.
Can you work with our developers?
Yes. We can work alongside your developers, with designs, components and interaction details shaped around the agreed implementation.
Is a working prototype a production app?
No. A prototype helps you explore and test the experience. Production engineering, security, integrations and release testing need their own agreed scope.
Can you improve an existing product?
Yes. We can start with the existing flows, identify the areas that need attention and agree a focused redesign scope.
What affects timing and cost?
The number and complexity of flows, research needs, content readiness, integrations and build scope all matter. Share your brief so we can define the work together.
How do we get started?
Tell us what you are working on, what needs to change and any dates or constraints. We will review the brief with you and agree the scope, deliverables and next steps.

items: Audience priorities
The people, needs and tasks the experience must support.

An agreed definition of what the design needs to improve.

Patterns that keep common actions consistent.
Responsive layouts
Screens designed around the devices in scope.
Interaction states
Guidance for loading, empty, error and success moments.

deliverables.title: Prototype toolkit
items: Core journeys
Connected screens that make the main tasks tangible.
Review scenarios
Specific tasks to guide feedback on the experience.
Design decisions
A record of the choices that shape the direction.
Refinement priorities
A clear order for resolving the remaining questions.

deliverables.title: Handover essentials
items: Design files
Organized source files for the agreed deliverables.
Component guidance
Notes on how patterns and states should behave.
Build collaboration
A practical route from design into implementation.
Launch review
Checks against the agreed design and website scope.

We define deliverables, responsibilities, review stages and timelines around the brief.
Bring feedback into the agreed review stages so the direction stays clear and the work moves forward.
Receive the agreed files and guidance, with any rollout or ongoing support scoped separately.

name: Branding & Graphic Design

summary: Give your business a visual language that works everywhere, from your first impression to the details people remember.
description: Explore Kyte's branding and graphic design work across identity systems, packaging and brand applications for businesses in India and beyond.
scope: Positioning & direction

Visual identity

Packaging & applications

Guidelines & rollout

Clear from the start
Deliverables, responsibilities and review stages are agreed around your brief.
faqs: Can you refresh our existing identity?
Yes. We can review what is working, identify what needs to change and agree whether a focused refresh or a broader rebrand fits.
Is strategy included?
We define the depth of positioning and strategy at the start. A full identity engagement and a focused graphic-design project need different scopes.
Do you design packaging?
Yes. Packaging design can be part of the engagement, with formats, production requirements and supplier responsibilities agreed in advance.
What files will we receive?
We agree the source files, export formats, applications and brand guidance in the proposal so the handover fits your team's needs.
Can you help apply the new identity?
Yes. We can scope a rollout across digital, print, packaging or content alongside the identity work.
How do we get started?
Tell us what you are working on, what needs to change and any dates or constraints. We will review the brief with you and agree the scope, deliverables and next steps.

line: Give people a reason to keep watching.
headline: Content with something to say.

description: Social media and content services from Kyte, including strategy, production, founder content and ongoing creative support for growing brands.
scope: Content strategy
Set a clear direction around your audience, channels and business priorities.
Social creative

Founder & personal branding

Production & publishing

Build the formats

fit: Your brand needs a more consistent presence.

Your team needs an ongoing creative and production partner.
You want founder expertise to become useful content.
reasons: Strategy meets production
Ideas are developed with the shoot, format and final channel in mind.

Clear from the start
Deliverables, responsibilities and review stages are agreed around your brief.
faqs: Which channels do you work on?
We choose channels around the audience and content brief. The scope sets out the platforms and formats we will support.
Is personal branding included?
Founder and personal-brand content is one track within this service. We work with your expertise and point of view rather than inventing a persona.
Who publishes the content?
Publishing responsibilities and access are agreed at the start. We can structure delivery around your internal team or an agreed managed workflow.
Are paid campaigns included?
Paid campaign strategy, management and media spend are separate scope decisions. Organic content work does not automatically include paid advertising.
How do you measure the work?
We agree measures around the objective, such as relevant engagement, qualified inquiries or content consistency. We do not guarantee follower counts or virality.
How do we get started?
Tell us what you are working on, what needs to change and any dates or constraints. We will review the brief with you and agree the scope, deliverables and next steps.

headline: Ideas made clear through motion.
summary: Explain a product, introduce an idea or build a campaign with video shaped around the audience and the job it needs to do.
description: Video production and animation from Kyte: explainer videos, product walkthroughs, motion graphics and campaign content for growing businesses.
scope: Explainer videos
Turn a complex offer into a clear story people can follow.
Product walkthroughs
Show how the product works through a focused, useful sequence.
Motion & animated campaigns

Production & cutdowns
Plan the footage, edits and channel-ready versions around the agreed brief.

Set the visual direction

Bring it to life

Prepare the delivery

reasons: Clarity before effects
The message and sequence come first, with motion serving the story.
Connected to your brand
Visual direction is shaped around the identity and audience.
Designed for its destination
Aspect ratios, captions and cutdowns are considered in the brief.
Clear from the start
Deliverables, responsibilities and review stages are agreed around your brief.
faqs: Do you handle the script?
Scripting and storyboarding can be included. We agree the information, reviews and subject-matter input needed from your team.
Animation or live action?
The right format depends on the message, available assets, audience and budget. We work through that choice in the brief.
Can you use existing footage?
Yes, subject to quality, format and usage rights. We review existing material before committing to the edit.
Can we get different versions?
Yes. Aspect ratios, cutdowns, languages and captions are scoped before production so delivery matches the channels.
How are revisions handled?
Review stages and revision rounds are agreed in the proposal, with script and visual direction resolved before the most production-intensive work.
How do we get started?
Tell us what you are working on, what needs to change and any dates or constraints. We will review the brief with you and agree the scope, deliverables and next steps.
